params.message:
Showroom download draws the slides in PHP; no browser on the server any more

The download (Settings, Showroom) photographed one slide page per vehicle in a
headless Chrome via Browsershot and puppeteer. That Chrome lived on the server,
not in the code: Delta hard-coded Plesk's node path, and the Forge deploy removes
node_modules after the asset build, so every press of the button was a 500
(Ilse, 2026-09-16). Decision: no browser on the server.

App\Support\ShowroomSlide draws the slide with Intervention Image on Imagick (GD
when Imagick is absent), from the same data and in the layout of the web slide:
black band with make, model and the dealer's name, address and logo; photo left,
year, fuel and mileage right; the skewed white blocks with price, warranty and
lease banner. Inter (two static instances cut from the woff2 the app ships) and
the Font Awesome TTF of the theme, so rendering does not depend on server fonts.
Same file shape for the TV players: 1920x1080 JPEG, image_{id}.jpeg,
showroom_fotos.zip. A vehicle without a price gets no price block; a missing
photo gets a neutral placeholder panel; a long name shrinks then gets an ellipsis.

The controller skips a vehicle whose slide fails and names it in the notice;
when nothing can be drawn the dealer gets one sentence and nothing is left
behind. Browsershot, puppeteer, the BROWSERSHOT_* config and the Screenshot
classes are gone; the Koppelingen check becomes "Showroom slides (Imagick)".
Rule S2-7.16 and the finding are rewritten; the CUTOVER.md aftercare item is
closed.

Docs: preview.md gets the storage/ subfolders step and the first-copy-before-
first-deploy order for a new Forge site.
